SuiteInformation.Title: Ionity Time-Series DB
SuiteInformation.Description: The Ionity Time-Series DB profile targets the data layer behind Ionity RMS and SCADA deployments: Ionity IO-Telemetry-SQLite (edge buffering) alongside PostgreSQL pgbench at scaling factor 100 (TimescaleDB base), SQLite single-thread inserts, InfluxDB 4/64 streams, ClickHouse and Apache IoTDB 100/200 devices from OpenBenchmarking.org.
SuiteInformation.Maintainer: Johan Wilhelm van Antwerp - Ionity (Pty) Ltd
